description: This PHP source file defines the class 'SafeAnalysisNodeVisitor' which implements the 'NodeVisitorInterface' in Twig's internal namespace. It is responsible for analyzing node safety for rendering, particularly managing and determining which parts of a Twig template are safe for output, such as escaping and filters.

classes.name: SafeAnalysisNodeVisitor
classes.description: Implements node visiting logic for safety analysis in Twig templates, determining which nodes are safe based on their type and context.

methods.name: setSafeVars
methods.description: Sets an array of variable names considered safe within the current analysis context.

methods.name: getSafe
methods.description: Retrieves safety information for a given node, returning an array of safety tags like 'all' or specific safety labels.

methods.name: setSafe
methods.description: Associates safety labels with a specific node for future reference.

methods.name: enterNode
methods.description: Called when entering a node during traversal; returns the node unmodified.

methods.name: leaveNode
methods.description: Called when leaving a node; updates safety info based on node type (constants, blocks, operators, filters, functions, method calls, attribute access).

methods.name: intersectSafe
methods.description: Computes the intersection of two safety label arrays, considering 'all' as a universal safety label.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the priority of this node visitor; used to determine traversal order.
